overview_description.description: AqlCare turns your regular Zoom calls with older loved ones into remote dementia screenings. Our guided prompts embed MMSE/MoCA questions into natural conversation, Whisper accurately transcribes speech, and our scoring engine benchmarks responses against clinical standards. No stress, no apps — just a simple call that helps catch cognitive decline early.
